text_block_list.text:
In preparation for the Satsuki Sho, Fuji
Kiseki has
entered the Yayoi Sho. The
crowd buzzes with
energy as they wait
for her grand entrance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She talks to some fans, gracious and
cheerful as
ever, causing yet another
person to fall victim to
her irresistible
charm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
